fields: A single hook can cost Milio the lane. Stay behind your minions at all times and hold Q so you can knock him back when he engages.
Thresh punishes sloppy positioning with picks, though your kit can stop his follow-up. Do not throw Q from predictable angles, and keep your defensive spells up whenever he looks for a hook.
Her long range and steady poke make the lane uncomfortable. Do not let her land free Q trades, and lean on your healing to stay healthy.
He can dive you or your ADC fast with W and R. Hold Q and your ultimate to break up his engage chain.
Rell has a strong engage and long CC chain. Save Q for her dive and avoid standing clumped with your ADC.
His poke and area damage make lane tough. Focus on not getting tagged by his spells over and over.
She has strong engage and burst, especially when disguised. Keep your distance and watch for a Flash into ultimate.
Swain applies constant pressure with area CC, and once he is in range he is hard to kite away from. Avoid letting him close the gap.
His hook, mobility and roams give constant kill threat. Q and R let you disengage, but an early catch can lose the lane, so play carefully in the first levels.
Very dangerous if she reaches you, and her mobility makes your usual spacing unreliable. Respect her threat range at all times.
Her engage is readable, so Q can interrupt her E and your ultimate can cleanse the follow-up CC. Positioning mistakes still get punished, so keep defensive spells ready.
His shield eats your poke and his passive punishes long trades. Keep Q and R for disengaging rather than trading.
Her disengage makes it hard to force fights. Play for scaling and do not waste Q into her peel.
Both supports protect well. Skip long poke battles and get value from buffing your carry instead.
Strong in melee range, but his engage is predictable. Keep distance and play around his cooldowns.
She pokes and heals well but is vulnerable to your Q. Punish her when her E and W are on cooldown.
His engage is predictable and you can interrupt his W, but his chained CC is still dangerous if it lands.
She can punish bad positioning and block your movement. Keep your distance and she is much less threatening.
His speed and slow control plus his ultimate make fights awkward, but you can still protect your team well.
He has long-range poke but becomes vulnerable if he misses his E. Your healing can absorb some of his pressure.
His engage is predictable, but one misstep can decide the lane. Stay behind minions, keep Q for his follow-up, and do not give him free openings.
Her Black Shield blocks your Q and her root punishes bad positioning. From level 6, your ultimate can fully negate her Q and R engage.
He threatens your ADC with engage, but his range is easy to read. Q him as he comes in or disengage after his combo.
She sustains well but is vulnerable to poke and pressure. Look for Q hits and punish her positioning.
Her W and ultimate can swing fights, but she lacks steady pressure on you. Save your ultimate for her CC.
Her Q is the danger; once it misses, she has little else to threaten you with. Play around her cooldowns.
She brings lots of teamfight utility, but you usually have enough tools to protect your ADC and cleanse her CC.
She puts little pressure on you directly, so the lane mostly comes down to how well her ADC plays.
Mostly a scaling matchup. Pressure her early and do not give her free poke.
Strong range and poke, but he is exposed when his E stun is on cooldown.
Strong early poke, but your utility outscales hers in longer games. Avoid needless early trades.
She pokes well but is vulnerable if her E misses. Use Q to interrupt her engage.
His early all-in is dangerous, but once you survive the first pressure your range and defensive tools make him manageable.
He pressures through roaming, but you can protect your ADC comfortably. Keep track of where he goes.
Hard to kill but has little reliable access to you. Play around his W and keep Q for his engage.
